scope: Official Donald Bren ICS recruitment page and UCI Recruit board; Computer Science, Informatics, Statistics and EECS listings.

findings.finding: ICS page lists faculty positions in Computer Science, Informatics and Statistics; teaching and research pools appear by department.

CS Project Scientist pool is open through 2027-06-30, last review 2026-08-01; requires a doctoral degree in Computer Science or related field; appointments depend on grant funding and are not guaranteed. Added under research.

CS Specialist pool is open through 2027-06-30, last review 2026-08-01; accepts BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science or related field; appointments depend on PI funding and are not guaranteed. Added under research.
Informatics Project Scientist pool is open through 2027-06-30, review began 2026-10-07; requires PhD in CS, IT or related field. Added under research.
Informatics Specialist pool is open through 2027-06-30, review began 2026-10-07; accepts BS/MS/PhD in CS, IT or related field. Added under research.
CS AI/ML faculty search remains active; full consideration by 2026-12-01, final date 2027-04-01; CS or closely related PhD required.
Informatics HCI faculty search remains active; full consideration by 2026-12-05, final date 2027-04-01.

Board confirms CS systems, postdoc, lecturer, project scientist and specialist pools, plus Informatics postdoc, project scientist, specialist and lecturer positions. Existing nine records remain live; refreshed lastSeenAt.
EECS AI/ML assistant professor search remains live; full-consideration date 2026-12-01, open through 2027-02-15.
EECS postdoc pool remains live through 2027-07-09 and requires a PhD in EE or CS.
